2607.01043.title: DART-VLN: Test-Time Memory Decay and Anti-Loop Regularization for Discrete Vision-Language Navigation
2607.01043.paper_summary: Memory-based discrete vision-language navigation (VLN) agents must act under partial observability, yet even strong frozen backbones remain vulnerable at test time. Two common failure modes are stale historical evidence at memory readout and inefficient local backtracking during action selection. We present DART-VLN, a training-free test-time control framework for discrete VLN. DART-VLN combines Test-Time Memory Decay, a read-side memory reweighting rule that suppresses stale and redundant evidence without rewriting stored content, with Anti-Loop Regularization, a lightweight next-hop penalty that discourages immediate reversals during action selection. The framework introduces no new learnable parameters and leaves the learned backbone unchanged. Experiments on R2R and REVERIE show a consistent pattern: decay-only provides stable read-side gains, while decay+anti-loop achieves the best overall quality-efficiency trade-off, yielding shorter trajectories, lower runtime, and improved navigation performance in key settings. Behavioral analysis further confirms that anti-loop regularization reduces local backtracking and improves path efficiency under frozen backbones. Overall, the results show that modest test-time control can make memory-based discrete VLN more reliable and efficient without retraining.
2607.01043.paper_summary_zh: 記憶基礎的離散視覺-語言導航 (VLN) 代理必須在部分可觀察性下行動，但即使是強大的凍結骨幹在測試時仍然脆弱。兩種常見的失敗模式是記憶讀取時的陳舊歷史證據和在行動選擇過程中的低效局部回溯。我們提出了 DART-VLN，一種無需訓練的測試時控制框架，用於離散 VLN。DART-VLN 結合了測試時記憶衰減，一種讀取側記憶重加權規則，能在不重寫存儲內容的情況下抑制陳舊和冗餘的證據，以及反迴圈正則化，一種輕量級的下一步懲罰，能在行動選擇過程中抑制立即的反轉。該框架不引入新的可學習參數，並保持學習到的骨幹不變。在 R2R 和 REVERIE 上的實驗顯示出一致的模式：僅衰減提供穩定的讀取側增益，而衰減+反迴圈達到了最佳的整體質量-效率權衡，產生了更短的軌跡、更低的運行時間，並在關鍵設置中提高了導航性能。行為分析進一步證實反迴圈正則化減少了局部回溯並在凍結骨幹下提高了路徑效率。總體而言，結果顯示適度的測試時控制可以使基於記憶的離散 VLN 更加可靠和高效，而無需重新訓練。
